faqs.q: Sec. 78-71. - Use of unexpected balance of proceeds.
faqs.a:
Any unexpected balance of bond proceeds remaining after the completion of the project
               for which such bonds were issued shall be paid immediately into the fund created for
               the payment of the principal of and the interest on the bonds and shall be used therefor,
               subject to the provisions as to the times and the methods for their payment as stated
               in the bonds and in the proceedings authorizing their issuance.
(Code 1981, § 27-72; Ord. No. 551, § 25(G), 5-14-1964)
